metadata.description: Ruud van Engelenhoven's AI agent setup: domain agents and skills for engineering leadership, careers and hiring, chief-of-staff work, would-be founders, go-to-market and agent operations.

plugins.name: cto-toolkit
plugins.description: A CTO office agent and the engineering-leadership craft behind it: weekly reviews, ADRs and specs, architecture reviews, incidents and postmortems, build vs buy, cost and threat reviews, EU AI Act assessments, tech debt, metrics, 1:1s, reviews, board updates and due diligence.

plugins.name: go-to-market
plugins.description: A go-to-market agent: ideal customer profile, positioning, messaging with proof, pricing and packaging, channels and launches, landing pages, nurture and outbound drafts, sales calls, proposals, case studies and a weekly pipeline and metrics review.

plugins.name: agent-ops
plugins.description: Operations for your AI agent setup: retros, skill and agent design, evals, library audits, instruction files, guardrails, parallel agents and repo onboarding.

plugins.name: career
plugins.description: Both sides of hiring. For hiring managers: outcome-first job descriptions, structured interview loops and evidence-based evaluations with a bias check. For job seekers: a job-search agent that tailors every CV truthfully, tracks applications and drafts every follow-up, and never sends anything.

plugins.name: chief-of-staff
plugins.description: A chief-of-staff agent: morning brief, inbox triage with drafted replies, meeting prep and notes, promise tracking, calendar defence, decisions, delegations and the weekly review. Never sends, accepts or deletes.

plugins.name: venture-lab
plugins.description: An evidence-driven lab for would-be founders: screen ideas, interview customers, run cheap experiments with pre-set kill criteria, decide continue or kill, then model the business, check side-project safety, readiness, co-founder fit and funding.
